Subject: Kickoff — post-signature implementation playlist and canary evaluation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for getting the SOW across the finish line — we've signed and returned the copy (attached). Our leadership has asked me to get a compact, actionable implementation playlist so we can coordinate procurement, infra, and training across our teams. High-level asks from our side: 

- A mutual action plan we can attach to our internal change request (include milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria).
- A concise canary evaluation plan with clear quality gates (functional checks + semantic eval samples).
- Estimated training days for product + ops and proposed migration windows.
- Any procurement inputs we need to finish (IP/insurance language, SLA exceptions).

Target timeline we discussed internally is to be live in May (we're aiming for the week of May 20). That may slip depending on procurement, so if you can give a few go/no-go gates and a fallback go-live (May 25), that would help.

I've attached the signed SOW and our initial list of internal stakeholders. Can we get a draft MAP and evaluation plan by EOD Wednesday so we can route to procurement and infra? Also proposing a 30–45 minute alignment call — any availability Wed afternoon or Thu morning (PDT)?

Thanks,
Liam

--

Program Lead, Platform Integrations
Archipelago Health

Hi Liam / Sara — great to kick this off. Welcome aboard.

Quick status: we've received the signed SOW (thanks) and pulled together two artifacts for your review: 
- MAP-Archipelago-implementation-v1.xlsx — mutual action playlist with owners, milestone dates, and acceptance gates.
- eval_plan_v1.md — canary evaluation checklist and suggested prompt/test sets.

Attachments are in this thread; summary below. If anything looks off, we'll iterate in the alignment call.

Implementation playlist (high level):
- Week 0 (Provisioning): token scopes, VPC peering request, KMS key exchange, baseline infra checklist. Owner: Archipelago infra (Liam) / Redwood infra (Soojin).
- Week 1 (Staging + Smoke): deploy model variant m-ggml-16Q (staging), run smoke test suite, KV-cache warmup with 100 exemplar calls. Acceptance: smoke pass, no P0 errors. Owner: Redwood (Soojin).
- Week 2 (Canary 1 — 5%): route 5% traffic from a single region (us-west) to Redwood Dedicated pool. Observability gates: latency p95 < 400ms, token billing within expected range, error rate < 0.5%. Semantic quality gate: pass on 90% of the baseline eval set (we included 50 seed prompts). Owner: Archipelago product + Redwood CS.
- Week 3 (Canary 2 — 20%): expand to 20% across two regions, run full evaluation harness (A/B vs. baseline). Acceptance: no regression in semantic eval > 95% of prompts, automated rollback triggers documented.
- Week 4 (Cutover window): phased migration of traffic with canary ramp to 100% (target go-live). Final training sessions scheduled.

Training / enablement plan: three instructor-led sessions (2h each): Ops runbook, Prompting & Quality Monitoring, Incident response & rollback. We'd plan a weekday+one follow-up deep-dive with engineers.

Eval plan highlights (in eval_plan_v1.md):
- Dataset: 200 labeled prompts (mix of L1-L3), tied to customer-critical flows.
- Metrics: semantic similarity, hallucination rate, latency, token efficiency.
- Acceptance thresholds: semantic pass >= 92% on high-priority prompts; automated alerts for drift > 5% post-go-live.
- Observability: link tokens to request ids, enable tracing and cost-per-request dashboards.

Procurement notes: we'll need to surface the SLA section and confirm any custom insurance/KYC asks. I've flagged the procurement workbook (procurement_requirements.xlsx) and linked the HubSpot deal record in the MAP.

Next steps:
1) Please review the two attachments and flag any objections by EOD Wed.
2) Alignment call — proposing Wed 04 Apr, 10:00–10:45 PDT. I've DM'd suggested invites; feel free to move.
3) If procurement needs anything earlier, loop procurement@archipelagohealth.com and we'll prioritize.

Attachments: MAP-Archipelago-implementation-v1.xlsx (Excel), eval_plan_v1.md (Markdown)

Best,

Marissa Cole

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Marissa — quick internal note after scanning the MAP and eval draft.

- Suggest changing Canary 1 from 5% to a 48-hour steady-state window at 3% to capture diurnal patterns; then ramp to 5% if gates hold. That reduces blast radius for initial semantic checks.
- Add a KV-cache warmup step that runs the top 20 query patterns to avoid cold-start quality anomalies.
- Recommend we schedule the first training session during Canary 2 week (so ops has hands-on while 20% is live).

I'll add these as inline comments to the MAP spreadsheet. If Soojin agrees, we can publish v1.1 before the Wed call.

—Monica
